question: How many claims were reported in August 2026?

report.interpretation: Count of claims with a report_date in August 2026 (2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31), across all products and states. I counted by report date, not loss date. August is complete as of the 2026-09-30 extract.
report.answer: 455 claims were reported in August 2026. Each claim_id appears once, so there are no duplicates.
